_comment: Maintained in the TraitorDash repository (pelican/). Import it in the panel under Admin > Eggs.
name: TraitorDash LiveKit
author: traitordash.opt237@passmail.net
description: The LiveKit media server the dashboard's voice chat uses (RFC 27): downloaded from LiveKit's own release, with the keys and ports from the variables. The server's primary allocation is the signalling port (put a TLS proxy in front of it); two more allocations carry the media.

startup_commands.Default: cd /home/container && if [ -n "{{NODE_IP}}" ]; then IP='"use_external_ip":false,"node_ip":"{{NODE_IP}}"'; else IP='"use_external_ip":true'; fi && printf '{"port":{{SERVER_PORT}},"rtc":{"tcp_port":{{RTC_TCP_PORT}},"udp_port":{{RTC_UDP_PORT}},%s} }' "$IP" > config.yaml && LIVEKIT_KEYS="$LIVEKIT_API_KEY: $LIVEKIT_API_SECRET" ./bin/livekit-server --config config.yaml

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# TraitorDash LiveKit installation (RFC 27)
#
# Downloads the LiveKit server (Apache-2.0, https://github.com/livekit/livekit) from its upstream release into bin/. It is not
# shipped with TraitorDash and runs only as a separate program. The version and a SHA-256 per CPU architecture are pinned: a
# different file is refused. Changing the version means changing this script; a new release is a decision, not an accident.
# Unlike the dashboard's helper download this one is the whole point of the egg, so a failed download fails the install.
DIR="${SERVER_DIR:-/mnt/server}"
mkdir -p "$DIR/bin"

VERSION="1.13.11"
case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64)          ARCH="amd64"; SUM="1e9ee90ca301e1842b2887fc77cb122759756a9c8aeb4334ee91de3325ec43fb" ;;
    aarch64|arm64)   ARCH="arm64"; SUM="2af6ce091d6b3c79d1677f8ff1bbb91a8007f40b2325c059b52d38383c0830b6" ;;
    armv7l|armv8l)   ARCH="armv7"; SUM="5f663a6498c3d81ef2dce55a3a1e7815aacfe78207e469abc0bd9c5b5ca5070b" ;;
    *) echo "LiveKit: no build for $(uname -m)."; exit 1 ;;
esac

TMP="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
URL="https://github.com/livekit/livekit/releases/download/v${VERSION}/livekit_${VERSION}_linux_${ARCH}.tar.gz"
echo "LiveKit: downloading ${VERSION} (${ARCH})"
if ! curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$TMP/lk.tar.gz" "$URL"; then
    echo "LiveKit: the download failed; reinstall the server to try again."
    exit 1
fi
if ! echo "${SUM}  $TMP/lk.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c --quiet -; then
    echo "LiveKit: the downloaded file does not match the pinned checksum and was discarded."
    exit 1
fi
mkdir -p "$TMP/x"
tar -xzf "$TMP/lk.tar.gz" -C "$TMP/x"
BIN="$(find "$TMP/x" -type f -name livekit-server | head -n 1)"
if [ -z "$BIN" ]; then
    echo "LiveKit: the download holds no livekit-server."
    exit 1
fi
cp "$BIN" "$DIR/bin/livekit-server"
chmod 755 "$DIR/bin/livekit-server"
LICENSE_FILE="$(find "$TMP/x" -type f -name 'LICENSE*' | head -n 1)"
[ -n "$LICENSE_FILE" ] && cp "$LICENSE_FILE" "$DIR/bin/livekit-server.LICENSE"
echo "LiveKit: ${VERSION} installed in bin/."

variables.name: API key
variables.description: The key the dashboard (LIVEKIT_API_KEY) and the media server share; letters, digits, dash and underscore, for example a word you make up. Not secret on its own.

variables.name: API secret
variables.description: The secret that goes with the key (LIVEKIT_API_SECRET on the dashboard), at least 32 random characters, for example from openssl rand -hex 32. Admin-only.

variables.name: Media port (TCP)
variables.description: A second allocation of this server: the port for media over TCP, for players whose network blocks UDP. 1024 or higher, and the same as the allocation.

variables.name: Media port (UDP)
variables.description: A third allocation of this server: the one port all media goes through over UDP. 1024 or higher, the same as the allocation, and open to the internet for UDP.

variables.name: Public IP address
variables.description: Leave empty to let the server find its public address itself (it asks a STUN server). Fill in the node's public IPv4 address if that finds the wrong one, for example behind NAT.
